_comment: Example answers of the write API. serve.py uses resume_home_conflict and resume_once_conflict as the 409 messages.

pause_ok.body: the changed item, shaped like /api/cron jobs[] or /api/webhooks routes[]

body.message: job {id} is paused because it works in the home folder: run `junees cron allow-home {id}` to accept this, or remove the job and add it again with --dir
route {name} is paused because it works in the home folder: run `junees webhook allow-home {name}` to accept this
job {id} was to run once, at a time that has passed; add it again
a write needs an Origin from this server
